name: decryptSources
description: 配置需要解密的矢量瓦片的sourceId。
usage:
// 浏览器
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://iclient.supermap.io/dist/mapboxgl/iclient-mapboxgl.js"></script>
<script>
  const result = mapboxgl.supermap.decryptSources.set(sourceIdsArray);

</script>
// ES6 Import
import { decryptSources } from '@supermapgis/iclient-mapboxgl';

const result = decryptSources.set(sourceIdsArray);

name: set
description: 设置需要解密的矢量瓦片的sourceId数组

name: add
description: 添加需要解密的矢量瓦片的sourceId
